description: FREE split-profile pre-check of one submitted catalogue (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only — whether each part of the report is assessable — with no shares, no group existence, and no counts. The full signed report is the paid split_profile_check call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet). Required on the free pre-check only.

catalogue.description: The one tool catalogue to profile: a JSON array of tool entries, or an object carrying a tools array of the same form. Each entry must be a JSON object; name and description, when present, must be strings; inputSchema, when present, may be any JSON value. At most 200 tools and 262,144 request-body bytes. Processed in memory only and never stored.

name: split_profile_precheck
